playbook.title: First-hour range breakout
playbook.rule: After 10:30 ET, if the open→10:30 move is ≥0.7 ATR, trade the first break of the morning high/low in that direction. Stop 0.15 ATR; target 2R.

meta.note: Today and all-time are the account's change in equity. Closed-trade P&L is the full entry-to-exit result and can differ when a position was opened on an earlier day.
